name: Shared Wealth
text: Each player with units adjacent to this planet may draw up to 1 action card. For each player that draws an action card, gain 1 trade good.
automationNotes: Each player with units in or next to the system gets a draw button; the explorer gains 1 trade good per draw.

name: Tourism Bureau
text: For each adjacent wormhole, anomaly, or legendary planet, gain 1 commodity.
automationNotes: Counts wormholes, anomalies and other legendary planets in and next to the system and gives that many commodities.

name: Direct import
text: Gain a commodity, then you may move up to 1 of your ships from an adjacent system to this system.
automationNotes: Gives 1 commodity, then offers to move 1 of your ships from an adjacent system.

name: Initial Investment Surplus
text: Spend 1 commodity or trade good to ready this planet.
automationNotes: Spend-a-commodity or spend-a-trade-good buttons ready the planet.

name: Cross-species Mingling
text: Place X infantry on this planet, with X being the number of planets in or adjacent to this system containing infantry not belonging to you, +1.
automationNotes: Places the infantry automatically.

name: Emergency Abort Signal
text: Attach: When the planet owner declares a retreat, if this system is within 3 tiles of the active system, they may target this system, and repair up to 1 damaged unit on successful retreat.
automationNotes: Retreat targeting and repair are not automated; resolve them yourselves.

name: Imperialistic Gates
text: Attach: after activating Mecatol Rex, Purge this attachment. Then, all ships that begin their movement in this planet's system may be treated to adjacent to Mecatol Rex.
automationNotes: Movement is not calculated by the bot; purge the attachment and move yourselves.

name: Local Tariffs
text: Attach: After a player activates a system, you may allow that player to move through this system as if it contained no ships. If they do, you may take 1 trade good from that player, and gain 1 commodity.
automationNotes: Movement through ships and the trade good payment are not automated.

name: Faux Altruistic Festivals
text: Each of your neighbors may give you a promissory note from their hand. Each that does may draw an action card. Then, draw an action card.
automationNotes: You draw 1 action card; each neighbor gets give-a-promissory-note buttons and draws 1 action card if they give one.

name: Distraction Efforts
text: Gain 3 trade goods, and you may make an extra Component Action.
automationNotes: Gives 3 trade goods and an extra component action button.

name: Wasteful Pirates
text: Roll 5 die. For each roll above 5, assign 1 hit to your ships, and gain 1 trade good for each hit assigned.
automationNotes: Rolls 5 dice, offers the assign-hits button for your ships here and gives 1 trade good per hit your ships can take.

name: Rich hostages
text: Place this card face up in your play area. When scoring a 1 point objective requires you to spend trade goods, influence, resources, or command tokens, purge this card to reduce the cost by 3.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area. When you score a 1 point spend objective you get a purge button; adjust the spending yourself (Negotiate Trade Routes refunds 3 trade goods). The bot's score check does not know the discount.

name: Subjectivity Equasion
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or spend 5 resources to Research any Blue technology.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a blue technology.

name: Destructive Elements
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or spend 5 resources to Research any Red technology.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a red technology.

name: Ancient Biological Specimens
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or spend 5 resources to Research any Green technology.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a green technology.

name: Hyper Algorithms
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or spend 5 resources to Research any Yellow technology.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a yellow technology.

name: Faulty Emergency Signal
text: Choose any number of your ships in the active system, and move them to your home system if no other player's ships are in the system.
automationNotes: Move-ship-home buttons, offered only if no other player's ships are in your home system.

name: Insatiable Fuel Source
text: All players with command tokens in this system remove them, and add them to their Tactics pools.
automationNotes: Every command token in the system returns to its owner's tactic pool.

name: Replication Arrays
text: Discard 2 action cards from your hand if able, and draw 1 action card from the Action Discard pile.
automationNotes: Discard buttons for 2 action cards, then the pick-from-discard buttons.

name: Interesting Contagion
text: Place a frontier token in each system adjacent to this one that contains no planets or frontier tokens.
automationNotes: Places frontier tokens in adjacent empty systems without one.

name: Emergent Defenses
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place 1 PDS from your reinforcements on this planet.
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the PDS.

name: Pilot Recovery Program
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place a command token in your fleet pool.
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then adds 1 fleet token.

name: Pilot Recovery Program
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place a command token in your fleet pool.
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then adds 1 fleet token.

name: Lost and Found
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place a destroyer in the space area of this planet if no other player's ships are in it's space area.
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the destroyer if no other player's ships are there.

name: Lost and Found
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place a destroyer in the space area of this planet if no other player's ships are in it's space area.
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the destroyer if no other player's ships are there.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose a card from the Hazardous discard pile and play it as if it was explored on the current planet. Then, purge this card.
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose a card from the Hazardous discard pile and play it as if it was explored on the current planet. Then, purge this card.
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose a card from the Hazardous discard pile and play it as if it was explored on the current planet. Then, purge this card.
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose a card from the Hazardous discard pile and play it as if it was explored on the current planet. Then, purge this card.
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Corrosive Discovery
text: Roll 3 dice. For each roll above 4, gain a trade good. For each below 3, one hit is produced against your ground forces on this planet.
automationNotes: Rolls 3 dice, gives the trade goods and offers the assign-hits button. The button lists ground forces on every planet in the system; assign to this planet.

name: Corrosive Discovery
text: Roll 3 dice. For each roll above 4, gain a trade good. For each below 3, one hit is produced against your ground forces on this planet.
automationNotes: Rolls 3 dice, gives the trade goods and offers the assign-hits button. The button lists ground forces on every planet in the system; assign to this planet.

name: Precision Laser Defenses
text: Attach: This planet gains Space Cannon 3 when it is the active system.
automationNotes: The planet gets Space Cannon 3 from the attachment data; it fires only in its own system.

name: Inhospitable Environment
text: Attach: For each infantry committed to, or produced on this planet, roll a die. For each number 3 or less, destroy 1 infantry.
automationNotes: Infantry landed with the land buttons or produced on the planet gets a roll button. Other ways of committing infantry are not detected.

name: Electromagnetic Flux
text: Attach: Mechs not owned by the owner of this planet lose their text and sustain damage abilities during ground combat.
automationNotes: Mech abilities in ground combat are not switched off by the bot.

name: Defensive Bastion
text: Attach: When this system is retreated into by your ships, if this system does not contain one of your command tokens, add up to 4 fighters from your reinforcement to the space area.
automationNotes: Retreating with the bot's retreat buttons into this system without your command token offers to place up to 4 fighters.

name: Repurposed Facilities
text: You may spend 5 resources to place a space dock from your reinforcements on this planet. If you don't, gain 1 trade good.
automationNotes: Space dock plus resource payment buttons, or 1 trade good.

name: Ancient Excavators
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 1 trade good, or spend 2 resources to gain the Scanlink Drone Network technology. This card may be used in a transaction.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 1 trade good, or purge it and spend 2 resources to gain Scanlink Drone Network. Can be traded as a relic in transactions.

name: Daunting Weapons Schematics
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 1 trade good, or spend 5 resources to gain the Dreadnaught II unit upgrade. This card may be used in a transaction.
notes: Using either option purges this card.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 1 trade good, or purge it and spend 5 resources to gain Dreadnought II. Can be traded as a relic in transactions.

name: Enhanced Mobility Core
text: Place this card face up in your play area. If you have Grav Drive researched, it grants 2 additional movement instead of 1. This card may be used in a transaction.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area and can be traded; the extra movement is not calculated.

name: Military Procedural Documents
text: If there are no mechs on this planet, you may replace 1 infantry on this planet with 1 mech from your reinforcements. Otherwise, gain a commodity.
automationNotes: Replace-infantry-with-mech button when the planet has no mech; otherwise 1 commodity.

name: Military Procedural Documents
text: If there are no mechs on this planet, you may replace 1 infantry on this planet with 1 mech from your reinforcements. Otherwise, gain a commodity.
automationNotes: Replace-infantry-with-mech button when the planet has no mech; otherwise 1 commodity.

name: Profitable Factories
text: Attach: When this planet is exhausted, gain 1 trade good and exhaust this card.
automationNotes: Exhausting the planet with spend or vote buttons gives 1 trade good once per round. Exhausting it some other way does not trigger it.

name: Carbon Consciousness
text: Attach: When this planet is exhausted, you may spend influence equal to this planet's resource value to ready this planet. If you do, place an infantry on the planet.
automationNotes: Exhausting the planet with spend or vote buttons offers to ready it and place 1 infantry, with influence payment buttons.

name: Efficiency Techniques
text: Attach: If anything on this planet contains the Production skill, this planet gains 2 production.
automationNotes: Adds 2 to the planet's production when units on it have production.

name: Affordable Mass Production
text: Attach: When Fighters are made using the Production skill of units within this system, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
automationNotes: Production cost drops by 1 when fighters are produced in this system.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal and resolve the next Industrial exploration card on this planet
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal and resolve the next Industrial exploration card on this planet
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on a different planet in or adjacent to this planet. If that number is zero, reveal and resolve the next industrial exploration card on this planet.
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on a different planet in or adjacent to this planet. If that number is zero, reveal and resolve the next industrial exploration card on this planet.
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on a different planet in or adjacent to this planet. If that number is zero, reveal and resolve the next industrial exploration card on this planet.
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on a different planet in or adjacent to this planet. If that number is zero, reveal and resolve the next industrial exploration card on this planet.
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Data Interchange Hub
text: Attach: During the owner of this planet's turn, they may transact with any player with ships in the same system as a wormhole.
automationNotes: The transaction permission is not given by the bot.

name: It's a trap!
text: A random player in last place with a home system more than 5 hexes away from this system places up to 4 destroyers in this system, instantly engaging in space combat with any player with ships in the active system.
automationNotes: Picks the player with the fewest victory points among those whose home is more than 5 hexes away (random tie-break); they place up to 4 destroyers and combat starts.

name: Systematic Sympathies
text: Destroy all units in this system. Players who lose four resources or more of ships from this effect permanently gain a Victory Point. Otherwise, they gain a trade good.
automationNotes: Destroys all units; players who lose ships costing 4 or more score the Systematic Sympathies custom objective (1 point), other players who lost units gain 1 trade good.

name: Pondering the Nebulae
text: You may discard 1 unscored secret objective. If you do, draw 1 secret objective.
automationNotes: Discard buttons for your unscored secret objectives in your cards info thread; a new one is drawn.

name: We're Lost, Captain
text: The speaker may choose any system that does not contain a planet or another player's ships. Move all ships from the frontier token system into the empty system, and place a command token from the player's reinforcements in the system if able.
automationNotes: The speaker picks the system; your space units move there and your command token is placed.

name: MacGuffian Outpost
text: Place this card face up in your play area. When you lose a space combat, you and the winner both gain 2 trade goods.
automationNotes: Goes to your play area. Both players get 2 trade goods when you lose your last ship to the bot's assign-hits buttons. Losing it any other way is not detected.

name: Unseen Danger
text: Destroy all of your ships in this system, and place an Asteroid Field Token in this tile. If you destroyed any ships, you may gain the Anti-mass technology if you don't own it.
automationNotes: Destroys your ships here, places an asteroid field token and offers Antimass Deflectors.

name: Foregone Discoveries
text: Reveal the top card of the Relic deck. Choose a player to gain that relic. The chosen player may transact with you during this action phase regardless of if you are neighbors.
automationNotes: Shows the top relic; the chosen player gains exactly that relic and may transact with you this action phase.

name: Overcharged Targeting System
text: Attach: All Space Cannon units on this planet have +1 added to their Space Cannon rolls
automationNotes: Units on this planet get +1 on space cannon rolls.

name: Production Relay
text: Attach: When Fighters are made using the Production skill of units within this system, choose a player. They place 2 fighters in their home system if it contains no other player's ships.
automationNotes: After you click Done Producing with fighters made in this system you pick a player for the 2 fighters. Other production paths are not detected.
